prompt:
Identify the data structure used in this program.

Input:
Program: String matching program
response:
The program uses a linked list to store the input string and its corresponding matches. The first node of the linked list is used as the head, which contains an empty string if no match has been found yet. Each subsequent node in the linked list stores one character from the input string that matched with the previous node's value. 

When a new character is added to the input string, it is inserted at the end of the current node’s value. When a match is made, the matching characters are removed from the nodes above them (i.e., the ones containing the same characters) until only one node remains. This process continues until all the nodes have been processed or there is no more data left in the input string.

prompt: Construct a logical argument for why recycling is important
response: Recycling is important because it helps to reduce the amount of waste that ends up in landfills and oceans.
